Section 5 of the principal enactment is hereby repealed
and the following new sections are substituted therefor: -

5.
(1) An application shall be made to the
Central Authority by the appropriate authority
of a specified country or specified organization
requesting  for  information  or  assistance  in
respect  of  such  criminal  and  related  matters
referred to in this Act. Such information shall
be  obtained  to  prevent,  detect,  investigate  or
institute  proceedings  in  respect  of  a  criminal
activity within or outside that country.

(2)  The  Application 
shall  be  made
substantially in the Form set out in the Schedule
hereto  and  shall  be  accompanied  by  such
documents as may be specified for that purpose
by the Central Authority to enable prompt action
under section 5A.

subsection (1), a request which conforms to the
